cues.zh: 其實，如果試了，請分享給我。

cues.en: I would love to see it, but you could potentially try this with another model.
cues.zh: 很想看看；也可以試著換另一個模型。

cues.en: See what happens.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: Stake.
cues.zh: 牛排。

cues.en: Okay, There we go.
cues.zh: 好，有了。

cues.en: So even though Model one performs worse quantitatively, it performs better qualitatively.
cues.zh: 雖然 model_1 數值表現較差，定性上卻較好。

cues.en: So that's the power of a visualize, visualize, visualize.
cues.zh: 所以這就是視覺化、視覺化、再視覺化的力量。

cues.en: And if we use Model zero also, which isn't performing too well, it gets it wrong with a prediction probability of 0.368, which isn't too high either.
cues.zh: 如果改用同樣表現不太好的 model_0，它就答錯，預測機率 0.368，也不太高。

cues.en: So we've talked about a couple of different ways to improve our models.
cues.zh: 已經談過幾種改善模型的方法。

cues.en: Now we've even got a way to make predictions on our own custom images, so give that a shot.
cues.zh: 現在甚至有了預測自己自訂影像的方法，試試看。

cues.en: I'd love to see your custom predictions.
cues.zh: 很想看到你的自訂預測。

cues.en: Upload an image here if you want or download it into Google CoLab using code that we've used before, but we've come a fairly long way.
cues.zh: 想要的話，上傳影像，或用之前的程式下載到 Google Colab；我們已經走了很長一段路。

cues.en: I feel like we've covered enough for custom data sets.
cues.zh: 我覺得，自訂資料集已經介紹得夠多。

cues.en: Let's summarize what we've covered in the next video, and I've got a bunch of exercises and extra curriculum for you, so this is exciting stuff.
cues.zh: 下支影片總結，也準備了很多練習與延伸學習，真令人興奮。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 到時見。
